title: Kōrerotia hei Oranga
intro: Ka puta mai tētahi āhua i roto i te hītori tapu, e mau ana i ngā merekara i whakahē i te tikanga o te taiao. I tae mai tēnei wairua mā te whakahau atua kotahi, i tiaki i tētahi matua mai i ngā whakapae nui, ā, i wehe atu i tēnei ao i mua i te taea e ngā mekameka whenua te here i a rāua. Ka horapa te kōrero mai i tētahi whāngai iti ki ngā rangi i runga. Ko wai rā tēnei?
clues: I tonoa mai ahau hei tohu, hei aroha hoki nā Allah ki ngā tamariki a Iharaira.
Kāore i rite taku taenga mai ki tētahi atu i mua — i puta mai ahau i te kupu atua 'Kia!' kāore he matua whenua.
I pāngia tōku mātua e te kōrero kino, engari i heke iho te whakakitenga tapu hei whakaatu i tō rāua harakore, hei whakaara ake hoki i tō rāua tūranga.
I a au e pēpi ana, i miharo te hunga i tōku taha mā te kōrero mārama mai anō i taku moenga hei whakakore i te ingoa o ōku mātua.
Nā te whakaaetanga a Allah, i hanga e au te ora mai i te paru mate, i hoatu he tirohanga ki te matapo, ā, i whakaorangia e au te repera ki taku pā.
I whakaarahia ahau ki te rangi i mua i te pānga mai o te kino ki ahau, ā, ka hoki mai ahau ki tēnei ao i mua i te taenga mai o te Hāora Whakamutunga.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
